heading: Claiming expenses
intro: When you go to court as a witness or a similar role, you can claim certain expenses from the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS).
whoCanClaimLead: You can claim expenses if you attend a pre-trial meeting or a trial as a:
whoCanClaimItems: parent or guardian of a witness who's under 18 years old
person with permission to claim, for example you are helping a witness attend court
whatYouCanClaimLead: Expenses are things that cost you money while attending the trial, for example:
whatYouCanClaimItems: loss of earnings, for example because you had to take time off work
claimLimits: There are limits to what you can claim.
receiptsRequired: You will need receipts and bank statements that show your spendings or loss of earnings.
howToClaimIntro: You can claim as soon as you have finished giving evidence as a witness, even if the trial is still ongoing.
howToClaimItems: look out for posters at the court with a QR code that links to the online service
apply online using https://claim-witness-expenses.cps.gov.uk/ (opens in new tab)
findOutMoreText: Find out more about what you can claim, or start an application on the
findOutMoreLinkText: Claim witness expenses service (opens in new tab)
